caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, woven textile sample displayed horizontally on a plain background. The textile is divided into three main horizontal bands of color: the upper band is red with a floral and vine pattern, the middle band is yellow with a rose and geometric motif, and the lower band is blue featuring leaves and a lacy geometric design. The colors are faded and some areas appear worn. Below the three colored bands, on the pale background of the fabric, the text "MADE BY PHILIP SCHUM Z.A. LANCASTER" is stitched in red thread. The textile sample appears attached to the background surface, and the edges are irregular and frayed. There is a small brownish stain near the top left corner.
title: Handwoven Table Cover
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
